challenged_source.claim: For S=gamma Z^2+2rZ, ||p_S||_(3/2) <= min(2|gamma|^(-1/3),(2|r|)^(-1/3)) for every cap-one Z.

counterexample: For gamma!=0 and any r, let Z=-r/gamma+U with U uniform on [-1/2,1/2]. Then S=gamma U^2-r^2/gamma and ||p_S||_(3/2)=2|gamma|^(-1/3), independent of r, so the claimed affine term tends incorrectly to zero as |r| grows.
repair: For 1<q<2 the sharp translation-uniform theorem is ||p_(gamma Z^2+2rZ)||_q <= [2^(q-1)/(2-q)]^(1/q)|gamma|^(-1+1/q). The exact gamma=0 external-coupling endpoint from auto26 remains valid: ||p_Q||_infinity <= p q |b|^(-1+1/p)|c|^(-1/p), in particular <=4/sqrt(|bc|), with p_Q in C_0.
scope: This refutes only the nonzero-gamma fiberwise affine-slope rescue and withdraws its piecewise Psi(gamma,c) consequence absent a new proof. It is not a counterexample to the full QFORM conjecture.
